framework.name: NERC CIP — Critical Infrastructure Protection Standards for Electric Reliability
framework.description: Mandatory regulatory cybersecurity standards enforced by FERC and NERC regional entities (WECC, SERC, ReliabilityFirst, Texas RE, MRO, NPCC) across North America for Bulk Electric System (BES) Cyber Systems, Electronic Security Perimeters (ESP), Physical Security Perimeters (PSP), Systems Management, Incident Response, and Supply Chain Risk Management.
framework.author: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC)

themes.name: BES Cyber System Categorization & Asset Impact Rating
Security Management Controls & Low Impact Protection
Personnel & Training, Background Checks & Access Revocation
Electronic Security Perimeter(s) [ESP] & Interactive Remote Access
Physical Security of BES Cyber Systems & PACS
Recovery Plans for BES Cyber Systems & Backup Validation
BES Cyber System Information (BCSI) Protection & Sanitization
Control Center Communications Security & Link Encryption
Supply Chain Cyber Security Risk Management
Physical Security for Critical Substations & Control Centers

controls.title: High Impact BES Cyber System Identification & Categorization
controls.description: Identify and categorize all High Impact BES Cyber Systems (including large generation facilities >1500 MW, control centers monitoring >3000 MW, and critical transmission substations >500 kV) based on NERC CIP-002 Attachment 1 criteria.

controls.title: Medium Impact BES Cyber System Identification & Categorization
controls.description: Identify and categorize Medium Impact BES Cyber Systems (including generation facilities 300–1500 MW, transmission substations 200–500 kV, and regional control centers) using NERC impact criteria.

controls.title: Low Impact BES Cyber System Identification & Asset Tracking
controls.description: Identify all Low Impact BES Cyber Systems (including smaller generation assets <300 MW and local distribution/transmission substations) and track baseline cyber asset inventories.

controls.title: Protected Cyber Asset (PCA) & EACMS/PACS Classification
controls.description: Identify and document all Protected Cyber Assets (PCAs), Electronic Access Control and Monitoring Systems (EACMS), and Physical Access Control Systems (PACS) connected to BES Cyber Systems.

controls.title: CIP Senior Manager Approval of Cyber Security Policies
controls.description: Develop and maintain 13 mandatory CIP cybersecurity policies, approved annually in writing by the designated CIP Senior Manager.

controls.title: CIP Senior Manager Formal Delegation of Authority
controls.description: Formally document any delegation of authority from the CIP Senior Manager to delegates, specifying scope and limits of delegated approval authority.
evidence_checklist: Delegation Letter Signed by CIP Senior Manager

controls.title: Low Impact BES Cyber System Cyber Security Plan
controls.description: Implement a Cyber Security Plan for Low Impact BES Cyber Systems addressing physical security, electronic access controls, malicious code risk, and incident reporting.

controls.title: Low Impact Removable Media & Transient Cyber Asset Security
controls.description: Enforce controls for transient cyber assets and removable media (USB drives, laptops) connected to Low Impact BES Cyber Systems, including malware scanning prior to connection.

controls.title: Quarterly OT Cyber Security Awareness Program
controls.description: Conduct quarterly cybersecurity awareness reinforcement to personnel with electronic or physical access to BES Cyber Systems, focusing on grid threats, social engineering, and physical security.

controls.title: Annual Mandatory Cyber Security Training for OT Personnel
controls.description: Require annual completion of role-specific cybersecurity training before granting unescorted physical or electronic access to High/Medium BES Cyber Systems.

controls.title: 7-Year Personnel Risk Assessment & Background Checks
controls.description: Perform background checks (identity verification and criminal history check covering prior 7 years) for all personnel before granting unescorted access, renewed every 7 years.

controls.title: Access Authorization & 24-Hour Access Revocation
controls.description: Maintain formal access authorization matrices and revoke electronic and physical access to BES Cyber Systems within 24 hours of employee termination or reassignment.

controls.title: Electronic Security Perimeter (ESP) & EACMS Isolation
controls.description: Enforce Electronic Security Perimeters (ESPs) around High and Medium Impact BES Cyber Systems. Route all inbound and outbound communications through an Electronic Access Control and Monitoring System (EACMS) firewall with default-deny rules.

controls.title: Interactive Remote Access (IRA) MFA & Intermediate Jump Host
controls.description: Require all Interactive Remote Access (IRA) sessions to pass through an intermediate jump host located in the OT DMZ with mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) prior to gaining access to BES Cyber Systems.

controls.title: Vendor & Third-Party Remote Access Control & Session Monitoring
controls.description: Enforce vendor remote access controls including time-limited access windows, continuous session recording, and immediate vendor session termination mechanisms.

controls.title: ESP Inbound & Outbound Port / Protocol Filtering
controls.description: Restrict ESP ingress and egress traffic to explicitly authorized ports and protocols necessary for operational control center or substation communication.

controls.title: OT DMZ Architecture & Bastion Isolation
controls.description: Establish a dual-homed Industrial DMZ (L3.5) separating IT enterprise networks from OT control perimeters so direct communication between enterprise IT and BES Cyber Systems is prohibited.

controls.title: Physical Security Plan & Physical Security Perimeters (PSP)
controls.description: Develop and maintain a Physical Security Plan defining Physical Security Perimeters (PSPs) around High and Medium Impact BES Cyber Systems, EACMS, and PACS.

controls.title: Physical Access Control System (PACS) & Alarm Monitoring
controls.description: Deploy card key/biometric PACS with electronic access monitoring and automated physical intrusion alarm generation at all PSP entry points.

controls.title: Visitor Control Program & 90-Day Access Logging
controls.description: Enforce visitor control procedures requiring continuous escort within PSPs and maintain visitor logs (name, organization, date/time, escort identity) retained for at least 90 calendar days.

controls.title: PACS Access Log Audit & Quarterly Log Review
controls.description: Retain physical access logs for at least 90 calendar days and conduct quarterly reviews of physical access logs to identify unauthorized physical access attempts.

controls.title: Unused Logical Ports, Physical Ports & Services Hardening
controls.description: Disable all unused logical ports, physical interfaces (USB, Ethernet), and unnecessary network protocols/services on BES Cyber Systems and PCAs, maintaining documented justification for all open ports.

controls.title: 35-Day Security Patch Assessment & Evaluation
controls.description: Evaluate security patches for applicability at least once every 35 calendar days. Apply applicable patches within 35 calendar days or document an approved Patch Mitigation Plan with compensating controls.

controls.title: Anti-Malware & Application Allowlisting Management
controls.description: Deploy anti-malware software or application allowlisting on all eligible BES Cyber Assets and PCAs, updating virus definitions/allowlists or documenting mitigation controls.

controls.title: Security Event Monitoring & 90-Day Audit Trail Retention
controls.description: Generate security audit logs for login events, failed access attempts, privilege escalations, and EACMS security alerts. Retain audit logs for at least 90 calendar days and review log summaries monthly.

controls.title: System Access Control, Passwords & 15-Minute Session Lockout
controls.description: Enforce password complexity (minimum 8 characters with upper, lower, numbers, special characters), 15-minute inactivity session lockouts, and 5-attempt account lockout policies.

controls.title: Default Password Change & Shared Account Hardening
controls.description: Change default vendor passwords prior to commissioning and eliminate or strictly control shared/generic accounts on all BES Cyber Systems and network infrastructure.

controls.title: Cyber Security Incident Response Plan (CSIRP) Development
controls.description: Document and maintain a Cyber Security Incident Response Plan (CSIRP) specifying roles, incident classification metrics, containment steps, and recovery procedures.

controls.title: Mandatory 1-Hour Incident Reporting to E-ISAC & CISA
controls.description: Report Cyber Security Incidents (or attempts that compromise BES Cyber Systems) to the Electricity Information Sharing and Analysis Center (E-ISAC) and CISA/NCCIC within 1 hour of determination.

controls.title: Annual CSIRP Incident Response Plan Exercise
controls.description: Test the Cyber Security Incident Response Plan at least once every 15 calendar months through operational exercises, tabletop drills, or actual incident response audit.

controls.title: Post-Incident Lessons Learned Review within 60 Days
controls.description: Update the Cyber Security Incident Response Plan within 60 calendar days of completing an incident response exercise or responding to a actual reportable incident.

controls.title: Cyber Security Disaster Recovery Plan (CSDRP) Specifications
controls.description: Document and maintain a Cyber Security Disaster Recovery Plan (CSDRP) detailing backup storage, system reconstruction procedures, and RTO/RPO targets for BES Cyber Systems.

controls.title: 15-Month CSDRP Disaster Recovery Plan Exercise
controls.description: Test the recovery plan at least once every 15 calendar months by simulating BES Cyber System failure and verifying full restoration from backup media.

controls.title: CSDRP Plan Update & Post-Test Review within 60 Days
controls.description: Review and update the recovery plan within 60 calendar days of completing a recovery exercise or experiencing an actual disaster recovery event.

controls.title: 15-Month Backup Media Integrity & Anti-Tamper Verification
controls.description: Test backup media at least once every 15 calendar months to verify backup data integrity and protect backup media from unauthorized physical/electronic tampering.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration Establishment & Verification
controls.description: Establish baseline configurations for OS versions, installed software, open logical ports, and security patches. Verify baseline changes prior to production deployment.

controls.title: 35-Day Configuration Baseline Monitoring & Drift Detection
controls.description: Monitor baseline configurations at least once every 35 calendar days for unauthorized changes and trigger automated security alerts for configuration drift.

controls.title: 15-Month Active Vulnerability Assessment
controls.description: Conduct a paper-based or active vulnerability assessment at least once every 15 calendar months for High and Medium Impact BES Cyber Systems, EACMS, and PACS.

controls.title: Transient Cyber Asset (TCA) & USB Malware Scanning
controls.description: Scan all Transient Cyber Assets (laptops, test sets) and removable media (USB drives) for malicious code using standalone scanning stations prior to connecting to BCA or PCA.

controls.title: Change Verification Prior to Production Deployment
controls.description: Test and verify all baseline configuration changes in a non-production test environment prior to deploying into live Bulk Electric System production environments.

controls.title: BES Cyber System Information (BCSI) Storage & Transit AES-256 Encryption
controls.description: Identify and authorize access to BES Cyber System Information (BCSI). Enforce AES-256 encryption for BCSI stored at rest and in transit across external or shared networks.

controls.title: BCSI Storage Media Sanitization & Destruction Certification
controls.description: Sanitize or physically destroy storage media containing BCSI prior to disposal, reuse, or release, generating signed Certificates of Destruction per NIST SP 800-88 guidelines.

controls.title: BCSI Access Authorization & Need-to-Know Management
controls.description: Maintain access authorization lists for BCSI repositories and review user access privileges quarterly to enforce strict need-to-know restrictions.

controls.title: Control Center to Control Center Communications Encryption
controls.description: Protect real-time Control Center to Control Center communication links carrying operational control data using IPsec VPN or TLS 1.3 encryption.

controls.title: Real-Time Control Data Integrity Verification
controls.description: Implement message integrity verification (HMAC-SHA256) on Inter-Control Center Communications Protocol (ICCP / TASE.2) data links to prevent spoofing or tampering.

controls.title: Inter-Control Center Communication Link Redundancy
controls.description: Deploy redundant physical and logical communication paths between primary and backup Control Centers to maintain real-time grid monitoring during link failure.

controls.title: Supply Chain Cyber Security Risk Management Plan
controls.description: Develop and maintain a Supply Chain Cyber Security Risk Management Plan approved by the CIP Senior Manager for procuring High and Medium Impact BES Cyber Systems.

controls.title: Vendor Software Integrity & Code Signature Verification
controls.description: Verify vendor software authenticity and integrity (digital signatures, SHA-256 checksums) prior to installing software, firmware, or patches on BES Cyber Systems.

controls.title: Vendor Security Incident Notification & 4-Hour Response
controls.description: Enforce contractual requirements for vendors to notify the utility within 4 hours of detecting a security incident affecting vendor products or remote access connections.

controls.title: Critical Transmission Substation Threat & Vulnerability Assessment
controls.description: Perform an initial risk assessment to identify critical transmission substations and control centers whose destruction would cause widespread Bulk Electric System instability.

controls.title: Independent Third-Party Physical Threat Evaluation
controls.description: Obtain an independent third-party verification of the physical threat evaluation for identified critical transmission substations and primary control centers.

controls.title: Physical Security Threat Mitigation Plan & Ballistic Barriers
controls.description: Develop and execute a physical security plan for critical substations including ballistic walls, thermal cameras, perimeter intrusion detection, and 24/7 physical security monitoring.
